selection: 50 editorially recognizable brands already in the local archive, selected to span industries, visual treatments, and intended actions. This is not a traffic, conversion, or quality ranking.
evidence: Archived full-page screenshots. SavedAt is the gallery download date; no screenshot capture date is asserted.
copy: Manually transcribed headlines, selected CTA/navigation labels, and supporting copy, checked against screenshots. Full-page OCR is unreviewed and may include UI mockup text, logos, legal copy, or errors. Line wrapping and Unicode font glyph identity are not promised.
facets: Industry, audience, intended action and style labels are interpretations. Composition observations and color/layout labels describe screenshot evidence.
retrieval: search-index.json is a compact discovery layer; packets/*.json expand verified text and visual evidence; records/*.json include full unreviewed OCR. Paths are relative to this folder. No harness workflow or verification policy is imposed.
scope: First-pass visual retrieval and hero-copy set. Detailed whole-page narrative/section annotation, actual CSS extraction, voice profiles, code recipes, and MCP implementation are not completed in this pass.
